title: Which part would you play?
sub: Pick your way through twelve scenes and we'll tell you who you are in this. Not your name — you.
disclaimer: Just for fun. Twelve scenes can't know you, and the name at the bottom is one that suited the part — nothing more.

type.lead_direct: The camera finds you the second you walk in. You say the line in episode two that everyone else was saving for the finale.
type.lead_careful: You carry the whole thing without ever raising your voice. Twelve episodes of waiting, and it lands because you made them wait.
type.firstLove_direct: You said it first, before either of you were ready. Whatever happened after, that's the scene people rewatch.
type.firstLove_careful: You never actually said it, which is why you're still in their head. Somebody still has the thing you gave them.
type.spark_direct: Two episodes of bad timing and you'd just ask. Great for the audience, a nightmare for the writers.
type.spark_careful: You two keep reaching the same door a minute apart. Nothing's been said, everyone can see it, and that's the whole genre.
type.second_direct: You say it in episode eight and step back cleanly when they pick someone else. Half the audience switches sides that night.
type.second_careful: You're the one who noticed they hadn't eaten. You'll never say it, and people will argue about you until the finale.
type.rival_direct: You turn up late, better dressed, and say the thing nobody wanted said. You're right, which is the annoying part.
type.rival_careful: You don't compete. You just keep turning out to have been right. By the time anyone notices, you're three scenes ahead.
type.bestie_direct: You take every scene you're in, and you weren't even meant to be in half of them.
type.bestie_careful: You drive them home, you remember what they said in episode one, and you never make it about you. They'd be lost.

arrival.title: First gathering. You know exactly one person here.

options.centre: Head for the middle of the room
options.known: Find the one person you know
options.joke: Say something stupid before anyone else talks

notice.title: They've spotted you from across the room.

options.deny: Say flat out that it's nothing
options.shield: Let it run rather than name anyone
options.feed: Add a detail that makes it better

alone.title: Somehow it's just the two of you.

rival.title: Someone else is looking at them too.

options.claim: Take the seat next to them first
options.measure: Work out what you're dealing with
options.yield: Step back and let them talk
options.needle: Say something just to get a reaction

public.title: Everyone's watching. The mic's come to you.

options.sing: Sing it properly, all the way
options.pass: Give it to someone who wants it more

secret.title: You've found out something you weren't meant to.

options.tell: Tell them before anyone else does
options.own: Say it out loud, right now, to the room
options.keep: Sit on it — telling helps nobody

hurt.title: It came out wrong and now neither of you is texting.

options.stand: You said what you meant. Wait.
options.wait: Leave it until they come to you
options.lighten: Send something funny like nothing happened

crossroads.title: Two options, and the episode ends either way.

options.chase: Go after the person, not the plan
options.take: Take the one where you're driving
options.gamble: Take the one nobody saw coming

options.first: Say it before they can ask
options.face: Say it to their face, in front of everyone
options.gift: Turn up with the thing they mentioned once

headline: The {temper} {role}
premise: Sixteen episodes. New term, new neighbourhood, new job — take your pick. There's one person you keep running into, and nothing has happened yet. Episode one starts here.

recap.seung_romance: Three scenes and you've been looking at one person the whole time. It shows.
recap.seung_presence: You've ended up at the centre of every room so far. People are watching you now.
recap.seung_warmth: You keep checking on everyone. Nobody's said thanks yet.
recap.seung_mischief: You've derailed two of the last three scenes. The script looks worried.
recap.jeon_romance: You can't play it off any more. Whatever you do next, everyone reads it as an answer.
recap.jeon_presence: The room changes when you talk. That's great until it isn't.
recap.jeon_warmth: People come to you first now. That's about to get heavy.
recap.jeon_mischief: Nothing you touched stayed where it was. The story's given up on stopping you.
recap.gyeol_romance: Everyone knows. The only question is whether you say it or let the rain handle it.
recap.gyeol_presence: You're in the last act because you walked here. Nobody gave you the seat.
recap.gyeol_warmth: Most of these people made it this far because of you. They don't know that.
recap.gyeol_mischief: You broke this drama three times and it got better each time. One scene left.
